The extracted candidate constants are heterogeneous: the raw mean and variance are dominated by a few literal exponents (for example 10^96 and 9.465e10), so the raw variance is not a meaningful measure of manuscript structure. The robust statistics (median, quartiles, log10|value|) and the threshold subset (0 < |value| <= 1) are the defensible comparison. Even then, the synthetic residuals live on the family-index scale (median ~ few hundred), whereas extracted thresholds cluster near 1e-5; the two distributions differ in kind, not merely in parameters.
